command: case "$${ORIGIN#http://}" in "$$ORIGIN") h=$${ORIGIN#https://};; *) h=$${ORIGIN#http://};; esac; case "$$h" in "$$ORIGIN"|""|*[!A-Za-z0-9.:-]*) echo "ORIGIN '$$ORIGIN' is no origin: set it to the scheme and host readers reach the door at, as https://app.example" >&2; exit 1;; esac; set -e -o pipefail; roots=$$(caddy adapt --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile | tr , '\n' | sed -n 's/^.*"root":"\([^"]*\)".*$$/\1/p' | sort -u); if [ -n "$$roots" ]; then find $$roots -type f ! -name '*.etag' -exec sh -c 'set -e; for f do h=$$(sha256sum < "$$f"); printf \"%s\" "$${h%% *}" > "$$f.etag"; done' sh {} +; fi; if [ -f /certs/localhost.pem ]; then export CADDY_TLS='/certs/localhost.pem /certs/localhost-key.pem'; fi; exec caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
